title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 2000 Go Fizzy Lychee Prefilled Pod & Refill
description: Fizzy Lychee from the Dojo Blast 2000 Go range pairs the exotic sweetness of Lychee with a fizzy, soda-inspired twist. The result is a light and uplifting fruit flavour with a sparkling finish that adds texture and energy to every puff. Each pack includes a 2ml transparent pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 2ml refill container, giving you up to 2,000 puffs of satisfying MTL vaping. With COREX 2.0 Mesh Coil technology built in, the pod delivers clean, consistent flavour and smooth vapour from start to finish. The transparent pod makes it easy to keep tabs on your e-liquid levels while offering a simple plug-and-play setup with the Dojo Blast 2000 Go device. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging 2. Remove the red silicone covers from the base and top of the refill pod 3. Attach the 2ml pod to the 2ml refill 4. Insert the combined pod into the Dojo Blast device, twisting to secure 5. Inhale to vape—no buttons or setup required. 6. When finished, replace with a fresh pod+refill pack.
